pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are characterized by irregular polygonal geometries with smooth pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch spatial area is larger on the dorsal flank, becoming smaller and more densely packed towards the posterior and hind limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space pathways form a continuous reticulated grid with frequent tri-radial junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible lateral surface.
